description: Create a Suno task on RunAPI (create mashup). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

lyrics.description: Exact mashup lyrics to sing. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

persona_type.description: Persona type. Declared type: string. Known values: "style", "voice".

prompt.description: Mashup brief for automatic lyrics. Declared type: string.

style_weight.description: Style adherence weight (0-1). Declared type: number.

upload_url_list.description: Two audio URLs to mashup. Declared type: array.

vocal_gender.description: Vocal gender. Declared type: string. Known values: "male", "female".

vocal_mode.description: Vocal generation mode. Declared type: string. Known values: "auto_lyrics", "exact_lyrics", "instrumental".

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: create_mashup
